summary: Mongolia waives visas under standing bilateral arrangements for a number of nationalities — among them the US, Germany, Canada, Japan, South Korea (until the end of 2026), Kazakhstan, Brazil and the UAE — and, for tourism trips of up to 30 days in 2026, for 34 more countries, including EU countries, the UK, Australia and New Zealand; citizens of the countries on the eVisa list can apply online for the official Mongolian eVisa.

passportValidity.text: The UK Foreign Office tells British nationals their passport must have an expiry date at least 6 months after the date they arrive in Mongolia. The Embassy of Mongolia in London asks visa applicants for a passport valid for a minimum of six months before the intended travel.

source.name: UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office — Mongolia entry requirements

travelInsurance.text: No official source we could read states whether travel insurance is required to enter Mongolia. The UK Foreign Office advises checking before you travel that you have appropriate travel insurance for local treatment or unexpected medical evacuation.

source.name: UK FCDO travel advice — Mongolia health

onwardTicket.text: No official source we could read states a return or onward ticket requirement. The Embassy of Mongolia in London advises visitors using the 30-day tourist visa exemption to book their return flight before arriving.

declarations.name: Immigration registration (within 48 hours)
declarations.text: Whoever provides your accommodation, whether a hotel, a landlord or a private host, must register you with the Immigration Agency of Mongolia within 48 hours. It can be done online through the agency's website or mobile app.

source.name: Immigration Agency of Mongolia — Registration of a foreign national
source.instrument: Law on the Legal Status of Foreign Nationals, Article 24.4

currencyLimits.text: The US State Department says Mongolian law requires travelers to declare cash, financial instruments and cryptocurrency worth 15 million tugrik (MNT) or more to customs on entry and on exit.

source.name: US Department of State — Mongolia international travel information

conflict.name: UK FCDO travel advice — Mongolia entry requirements
conflict.states: Declare cash or travellers cheques worth USD 10,000 or more

notes: The UK Foreign Office says there are strict rules on goods you can take into or out of Mongolia, and you must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty. If you become involved in a customs dispute or investigation, you may be held in Mongolia until it is resolved.
The UK Foreign Office says you can take in up to 15 million tugriks. Canada's travel advice says penalties for illegal drugs are severe, with jail sentences and heavy fines.

payments.text: Canada's travel advice says US dollars and credit cards are accepted in hotels and some restaurants, mainly in Ulaanbaatar, and advises carrying local currency, especially in rural areas.

safety.text: The UK Foreign Office says pickpockets may operate in markets and crowded public places, with the risk rising during Tsagaan Sar and Naadam; violent incidents are rare, but foreigners have been assaulted and robbed in Ulaanbaatar, and it advises avoiding being out alone at night. It says weather conditions often change without warning, and that outside the capital only about 10% of roads are tarmacked.

source.name: UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office — Mongolia safety and security

bestTimeToVisit.text: No official source we could read gives a best time to visit Mongolia. Canada's travel advice says temperatures range from about -35 to -40°C in winter to +35°C in summer, that heavy rains from mid-July to mid-September can cause flooding, and that dust storms occur in May and June.

idp.text: Mongolia is a party to the 1968 Vienna Convention on Road Traffic but not to the 1949 Geneva one. The UK Foreign Office says UK drivers need a 1968 International Driving Permit and their UK licence, and that the 1949 permit is no longer accepted.

driving.text: Mongolia is a party to the 1968 Vienna Convention on Road Traffic but not to the 1949 Geneva one. The UK Foreign Office says UK drivers need a 1968 International Driving Permit and their UK licence, and that the 1949 permit is no longer accepted; the Government of Canada says you must carry an International Driving Permit. No official source we could read states for how long a foreign licence may be used.

tips.text: The visa waivers for EU (except German), UK, Australian and New Zealand passports rest on a temporary exemption the Government granted 34 countries for tourism in 2026, and South Korea's runs to 31 December 2026. The Embassy of Mongolia in London says the temporary exemption is valid only until the end of 2026.

Your hotel, landlord or private host must register you with the Immigration Agency within 48 hours of arrival, whatever the length of your stay (Law on the Legal Status of Foreign Nationals, Article 24.4).
Canada's travel advice says credit cards are accepted mainly in Ulaanbaatar hotels and some restaurants, and advises carrying local currency, especially in rural areas.

Canada's travel advice says winter temperatures can fall to about -35 to -40°C, and the UK Foreign Office says weather conditions often change without warning, with frequent warnings for heavy snow and blizzards. The UK Foreign Office also says only about 10% of roads outside the capital are tarmacked.

faq.question: Do I need a visa for Mongolia?
faq.answer: The US, Germany, Canada, Japan, South Korea, Brazil, the UAE and other countries have standing visa waivers of 14 to 90 days, and for 2026 the Government has also exempted 34 countries — including EU countries, the UK, Australia and New Zealand — for tourism trips of up to 30 days. Citizens of the countries on the eVisa list can apply online for the Mongolian eVisa at evisa.mn.

faq.question: How long can EU citizens stay in Mongolia visa-free?
faq.answer: Up to 30 days. Citizens of every EU country except Germany are covered by the exemption the Government of Mongolia granted 34 countries for tourism trips in 2026; Germans have a standing bilateral waiver for up to 30 days.

faq.question: How does the Mongolian eVisa work?
faq.answer: You apply online at evisa.mn, pay the eVisa fee and, if the application is approved, receive the electronic travel authorisation by e-mail within 48 hours. The tourist eVisa allows a stay of up to 30 days.

faq.question: How long can US citizens stay in Mongolia?
faq.answer: US passport holders can visit Mongolia visa-free for up to 90 days under a bilateral arrangement in force since 2001. Whoever provides your accommodation must register you with the Immigration Agency within 48 hours of arrival.

faq.question: Do I have to register with immigration in Mongolia?
faq.answer: Yes, whatever the length of your stay: under Article 24.4 of the Law on the Legal Status of Foreign Nationals, whoever provides your accommodation — a hotel, a landlord or a private host — must register you with the Immigration Agency within 48 hours, online or through the agency's mobile app.
